title: Unblocking evidence
current: A blocker at done always satisfies fact:merged regardless of edge age. For an unfinished blocker, fact:merged requires its recorded merged_at strictly after the edge’s created_at. A blocker with no recorded landing reads merge_not_landed, a normal wait; merge_landing_unverified means the recorded landing time is invalid or the edge has no creation time. Earlier landings, branch ancestry and other lifecycle statuses cannot clear an unfinished blocker’s newly declared wait. When rework returns a landed blocker to a stage before release, its satisfied fact:merged edges wait again as merge_relanding_owed until a newer landing is recorded, in every gate reader and the fleet report's available and waiting-chain lines; its close-out move to release does not count as a return. Create a new edge before a needed re-landing of a blocker that was not returned; updates preserve the clock. Each durable edge and blocker landing owns its dependency notice identity, so a re-landing after a return notifies the dependent again. Record a correction wait only when a QA finding is in the dependent's own item and another item must land first; a failure report naming other items is no reason to depend on them. fact:merged fits a fix that ships in the dependent's release; status:done requires completion; fact:deployed:ENV also requires durable completion attribution to that registered environment, so use it only when the dependent needs the fix live before its own release, because composition skips a dependent whose blocker ships in that same release. Same-run co-scheduling permits admission, not persisted satisfaction or proof of an available retest target. Reread all remaining blockers on any notice. Creating a blocking fact:merged edge refuses as dependency_blocker_already_landed when the blocker has a recorded landing and its pinned workflow places it past code work; the refusal names the landing and says no merge dependency is needed. Reopened code work may take an edge before its next landing. Existing edges, completion waits and coordination records retain their rules.
